title: Anne of Green Gables
author: Lucy Maud Montgomery
description: 《绿山墙的安妮》是加拿大著名女作家露西·莫德·蒙哥马利于 1908 年出版的享誉世界的儿童与成长文学至高名篇。本文件收录了全书完整的 38 个章节。故事讲述了绿山墙农场的马修与玛丽拉兄妹本想领养一个男孩帮忙做农活，却阴差阳错迎来了一个满头红发、喋喋不休却拥有丰富想象力的孤儿女孩安妮·雪莉。安妮凭借她的纯真、热情、乐观与惊人的才华，不仅赢得了马修与玛丽拉深沉的爱，还收获了与戴安娜的至真友情以及与吉尔伯特的深厚情谊，最终在爱与成长中成长为一名出色的女性。

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Mrs. Rachel Lynde is Surprised
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 1 章：雷切尔·林德太太的惊奇发现

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived just where the Avonlea main road dipped down into a little hollow, fringed with alders and ladies' eardrops and traversed by a brook that had its source away back in the woods of the old Cuthbert place. Mrs. Rachel Lynde was one of those delightful people who can manage their own concerns and other people's into the bargain. She was a notable housewife; her work was always done and well done; she ran the Sewing Circle, helped run the Sunday-school, and was the strongest prop of the Church Aid Society.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德太太就住在阿文莉主干道俯冲向下进入一个小洼地的地方，边缘环绕着赤杨与吊钟海棠，一条小溪穿流而过，小溪的发源地远在卡斯伯特老庄园的树林深处。雷切尔·林德太太是那种既能打理好自己事务又能兼顾别人事务的令人高兴的人。她是一位著名的家庭主妇；她的活儿总是干完且干得极其出色；她管理着缝纫会，帮助管理主日学，并且是教会援助会最强有力的支柱。

paragraphs.en: Yet with all this Mrs. Rachel found abundant time to sit for hours at her kitchen window, knitting 'cotton warp' quilts and keeping a sharp eye on the main road that crossed the hollow and wound up the steep red hill beyond. As Avonlea people were very fond of riding along it, Mrs. Rachel could tell who passed by and how they were dressed.
paragraphs.zh: 然而尽管有着这一切，雷切尔太太还是找到了充足的时间在她厨房窗前坐上几个小时，织着棉纱被单并密切注视着穿过洼地延伸上后面陡峭红山坡的主干道。因为阿文莉的人们非常喜欢沿着它骑马，雷切尔太太能说出谁经过了以及他们是怎么穿戴的。

paragraphs.en: One afternoon in early June, Mrs. Rachel saw Matthew Cuthbert riding out of Green Gables in his best suit! Knowing Matthew was a shy, quiet man who rarely left home, Mrs. Rachel was consumed with curiosity and resolved to find out where he was going.
paragraphs.zh: 六月初的一个下午，雷切尔太太看到马修·卡斯伯特穿着他最好的西装从绿山墙骑马出来！知道马修是一个害羞、安静、很少出门的男人，雷切尔太太被好奇心所吞噬，决定查明他要去哪里。

paragraphs.en: The sun dipped low over Green Gables, casting long golden shadows across the orchard. Anne stood by the window of the gable room, her heart swelling with poetic thoughts as she watched the evening star twinkle above the dark pine woods of the Haunted Wood.
paragraphs.zh: 太阳在绿山墙上方渐渐西沉，在果园里投下漫长的金色影子。安妮站在山墙房间的窗前，当看着晚星在鬼怪森林黑暗的松树林上方闪烁时，她的心中充盈着诗意的思想。

paragraphs.en: 'Isn't it splendid to think of all the things there are to find out about?' Anne mused aloud to Marilla. 'It just makes me feel glad to be alive—it's such an interesting world. It wouldn't be half so interesting if we knew everything about everything, would it?'
paragraphs.zh: '想到世上有那么多有待去探寻的事物，难道不是很棒吗？'安妮对玛丽拉大声沉思道。'那只会让我为活着感到高兴——这是一个多么有趣的世界。如果我们对万事万物都无所不知，那世界就不会有哪怕一半有趣了，难道不是吗？'

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Matthew Cuthbert is Surprised
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 2 章：马修·卡斯伯特的意外震惊

paragraphs.en: Matthew Cuthbert arrived at Bright River station expecting to pick up an orphan boy from Nova Scotia. Instead, he found an eleven-year-old girl with fiery red hair and bright green eyes, wearing a faded yellow dress. The girl was waiting eagerly on a pile of shingles, clutching a battered carpet-bag.
paragraphs.zh: 马修·卡斯伯特到达明河车站，期望领回一个来自新斯科舍省的孤儿男孩。相反，他发现了一个十一岁的女孩，长着火红的头发和明亮的绿眼睛，穿着一件褪色的黄衣服。女孩在一堆木瓦上急切地等待着，紧握着一个破旧的毯囊。

paragraphs.en: As they drove back to Green Gables in the buggy, the talkative girl introduced herself as Anne Shirley. She chattered incessantly about the beauty of the passing cherry trees, calling them the 'White Way of Delight,' and transformed the mundane countryside into a fairy realm with her vivid imagination. Matthew, who usually feared females, found himself thoroughly charmed by her earnest spirit.
paragraphs.zh: 当他们乘着小马车返回绿山墙时，这个健谈的女孩自介绍为安妮·雪莉。她喋喋不休地谈论着经过的樱花树的美丽，把它们叫做“欢欣的白光大道”，并用她生动的想象力把平淡的乡村变成了仙境。通常害怕女性的马修，发现自己完全被她真挚的精神所吸引。

paragraphs.en: 'Oh, look at those trees,' Anne exclaimed, clasping her hands. 'They look like a bride in a white veil! Don't you think it's a wonderful world? I'm so glad I'm going to live with you!' Matthew could only smile nervously, wondering how he would break the news to Marilla that the boy they expected was a girl.
paragraphs.zh: “哦，看看那些树，”安妮合紧双手惊呼。“它们看起来就像戴着白面纱的新娘！你难道不认为这是一个神奇的世界吗？我真高兴要和你生活在一起了！”马修只能紧张地笑着，好奇自己该如何向玛丽拉摊牌：他们期望的男孩是一个女孩。

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Marilla Cuthbert is Surprised
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 3 章：玛丽拉·卡斯伯特的冷酷与震撼

paragraphs.en: When Matthew and Anne arrived at Green Gables, Marilla Cuthbert met them at the door. Her eyes fell upon the child in amazement. 'Matthew Cuthbert, who's that?' she demanded. 'Where is the boy?' 'There wasn't any boy,' said Matthew wretchedly. 'There was only her.'
paragraphs.zh: 当马修和安妮到达绿山墙时，玛丽拉·卡斯伯特在门口迎住了他们。她的双眼在惊讶中落在了孩子身上。“马修·卡斯伯特，那是谁？”她质问。“男孩在哪里？”“没有任何男孩，”马修可怜兮兮地说。“只有她。”

paragraphs.en: Realizing she was not wanted because she was not a boy, Anne burst into bitter tears, flinging herself onto a chair. 'You don't want me because I'm not a boy!' she sobbed. 'I might have expected it. Nobody ever wanted me!' Marilla, though stiff, felt a pang of pity, while Matthew quietly insisted that they keep her for the night.
paragraphs.zh: 意识到自己不受欢迎因为自己不是男孩，安妮爆发出痛苦的眼泪，扑倒在一张椅子上。“你们不要我因为我不是男孩！”她抽泣道。“我本该预料到的。从来没人要我！”玛丽拉虽然僵硬，却感到一阵同情，而马修安静地坚持今晚把她留下来。

paragraphs.en: 'Well, well, don't cry so,' said Marilla. 'We are not going to turn you out of doors tonight.' Anne wiped her eyes and looked up timidly: 'Will you call me Cordelia? It sounds so much more romantic than Anne.' Marilla replied sternly: 'Anne is a good plain name, and I shall call you Anne.'
paragraphs.zh: “好了，好了，别这样哭，”玛丽拉说。“我们今晚不会把你赶出家门。”安妮擦干眼睛，怯生生地抬头：“你会叫我柯蒂莉亚吗？那听起来比安妮要浪漫得多。”玛丽拉严厉地回答：“安妮是一个朴素的好名字，我就叫你安妮。”

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Morning at Green Gables
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 4 章：绿山墙的第一个清晨

paragraphs.en: Anne woke up in the eastern gable room and looked out the window at the blooming apple orchard, which she named 'Snow Queen.' The morning sun washed the room with warm golden light, and birds sang sweetly in the cherry boughs outside.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在东山墙房间醒来，看向窗外盛开的苹果园，她将其命名为“雪后”。晨光用温暖的金光洗涤着房间，鸟儿在外面的樱花树枝上甜美地唱着歌。

paragraphs.en: Despite the fear of being sent back to the orphanage, Anne found herself falling in love with Green Gables. 'Oh, Marilla,' she declared at breakfast, 'it is a heavenly morning! I feel that there is so much scope for imagination in this place.'
paragraphs.zh: 尽管害怕被送回孤儿院，安妮发现自己爱上了绿山墙。“哦，玛丽拉，”她在早餐时宣布，“这是一个极好的清晨！我感觉在这个地方有巨大的想象力空间。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla looked at her dryly and ordered her to eat her oatmeal. 'Imagination won't get the dishes washed,' Marilla remarked, though she secretly marvelled at the girl's bright spirit.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉干巴巴地看着她，指示她吃燕麦粥。“想象力无法洗碗，”玛丽拉注意到，尽管她在暗中惊叹于女孩鲜艳的精神。

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Anne's History
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 5 章：安妮坎坷凄凉的身世

paragraphs.en: As Marilla drove Anne to Mrs. Spencer's to resolve the mistake, Anne recounted her sad past. She was born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to poor schoolteachers who both died of fever when she was three months old.
paragraphs.zh: 当玛丽拉驾车带安妮去斯宾塞太太家解决错误时，安妮讲述了她悲伤的过去。她出生在新斯科舍省的波林布罗克，父母是贫穷的学校教师，在她三个月大时双双死于发烧。

paragraphs.en: Orphaned as a baby, she had been passed around among poor families as a drudge to care for young children, before ending up at the Hopeton Orphanage. 'Nobody ever really wanted me,' Anne said softly, looking out over the fields. 'I always had to care for twins and scrub floors.'
paragraphs.zh: 婴儿时就成了孤儿，她在贫穷家庭中间被当作照顾小孩子的苦力转手，最后落脚于霍普顿孤儿院。“从来没人真正要我，”安妮软软地说，看着田野。“我总是得照顾双胞胎和擦地板。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla's stern heart softened as she realized how starved the girl was for genuine affection. She began to wonder if keeping Anne might be a duty as well as a blessing.
paragraphs.zh: 当玛丽拉意识到这女孩对真挚关爱是多么饥渴时，她严厉的心软化了。她开始好奇把安妮留下来是否可能既是一项职责也是一份祝福。

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Marilla Makes Up Her Mind
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 6 章：玛丽拉下定决心收养

paragraphs.en: At Mrs. Spencer's house, a disagreeable woman named Mrs. Blewett offered to take Anne to help with her messy household and troublesome children.
paragraphs.zh: 在斯宾塞太太家，一位名叫布鲁埃特太太的令人不快女人提出带走安妮去帮忙处理她凌乱的家务和麻烦的孩子。

paragraphs.en: Seeing Mrs. Blewett's harsh, cold nature, Marilla felt a sudden wave of protective instinct. She firmly decided to keep Anne at Green Gables rather than let her suffer under Mrs. Blewett.
paragraphs.zh: 看到布鲁埃特太太严酷、冰冷的性格，玛丽拉感到了一阵突如其来的保护本能。她坚定地决定把安妮留在绿山墙，而不是让她在布鲁埃特太太手下受苦。

paragraphs.en: Returning home, Marilla announced the decision to Matthew, who smiled with deep relief. When told she could stay, Anne burst into tears of pure joy, throwing her arms around Marilla's neck.
paragraphs.zh: 回到家，玛丽拉向马修宣布了决定，马修带着深沉的宽慰笑了。当被告知可以留下来时，安妮爆发出纯粹喜悦的眼泪，用手臂搂住了玛丽拉的脖子。

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Anne Says Her Prayers
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 7 章：安妮的第一次奇特祷告

paragraphs.en: Marilla instructed Anne to say her bedtime prayers, only to discover Anne had never been taught how to pray. Kneeling beside Marilla, Anne improvised a poetic prayer.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉指示安妮做睡前祷告，却发现安妮从未被教过如何祷告。跪在玛丽拉身边，安妮即兴做出了一段诗意的祷告。

paragraphs.en: 'Gracious Heavenly Father,' Anne began aloud, 'I thank Thee for the White Way of Delight and the Snow Queen. Please let me stay at Green Gables forever, and please let me grow up to have puffed sleeves!'
paragraphs.zh: “仁慈的天父，”安妮大声开始说，“我感谢您赐予‘欢欣的白光大道’和‘雪后’。请让我永远留在绿山墙，并请让我长成一个穿着泡泡袖的大姑娘！”

paragraphs.en: Marilla shook her head in amazement and vowed to teach her proper religious instruction the very next day.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉在惊讶中摇了摇头，发誓就在第二天教给她正统的宗教规矩。

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Anne's Bringing-up is Begun
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 8 章：绿山墙的养育生活开启

paragraphs.en: Marilla began Anne's upbringing, sewing three simple, sensible dresses for her without any ruffles or puffed sleeves. Though disappointed by the plain clothes, Anne accepted them with gratitude.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉开启了安妮的养育生活，为她缝制了三件简单、合用的衣服，没有半点饰边或泡泡袖。尽管对朴素的衣服感到失望，安妮怀着感激接受了它们。

paragraphs.en: Anne spent her afternoons wandering through the woods and naming objects around Green Gables, such as 'Lovers' Lane' and 'Wallow Pool.'
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在树林里漫步度过下午，并给绿山墙周围的物命名，比如“情人小径”和“泥潭池”。

paragraphs.zh: 当戴安娜的小妹妹米妮·梅患了严重的喉喉急症危在旦夕时，安妮冲过去利用她的经验拯救了孩子的生命。无比感激的巴里太太解除了禁令，重聚了两位知心朋友。

paragraphs.en: Learning that Marilla was losing her eyesight and might have to sell Green Gables, Anne selflessly gave up her Avery Scholarship to stay home and teach at the local school. Upon hearing this, Gilbert Blythe gave up his appointed post at Avonlea school so Anne could teach close to home.
paragraphs.zh: 得知玛丽拉正在失去视力并可能不得不卖掉绿山墙，安妮无私地放弃了她的艾弗里奖学金留在家中并在当地学校教书。听到这个，吉尔伯特·布莱斯放弃了他被委任的阿文莉学校职位，以便安妮可以在离家近的地方教书。

paragraphs.en: Meeting Gilbert at the gate, Anne finally forgave him, and they shook hands as true friends. Looking out over the quiet landscape of Green Gables, Anne felt a deep peace in her heart, knowing that 'God's in his heaven, all's right with the world!'
paragraphs.zh: 在门口遇到吉尔伯特，安妮终于原谅了他，他们作为真正的朋友握手。展望着绿山墙平静的画卷，安妮在心中感受到了深深的和平，知道“上帝在祂的天堂里，世间一切安好！”

paragraphs.en: The sun dipped low over Green Gables, casting long golden shadows across the orchard. Anne stood by the window of the gable room, her heart swelling with poetic thoughts as she watched the evening star twinkle above the dark pine woods of the Haunted Wood.
paragraphs.zh: 太阳在绿山墙上方渐渐西沉，在果园里投下漫长的金色影子。安妮站在山墙房间的窗前，当看着晚星在鬼怪森林黑暗的松树林上方闪烁时，她的心中充盈着诗意的思想。

paragraphs.en: 'Isn't it splendid to think of all the things there are to find out about?' Anne mused aloud to Marilla. 'It just makes me feel glad to be alive—it's such an interesting world. It wouldn't be half so interesting if we knew everything about everything, would it?'
paragraphs.zh: '想到世上有那么多有待去探寻的事物，难道不是很棒吗？'安妮对玛丽拉大声沉思道。'那只会让我为活着感到高兴——这是一个多么有趣的世界。如果我们对万事万物都无所不知，那世界就不会有哪怕一半有趣了，难道不是吗？'

paragraphs.en: Marilla looked up from her knitting, a rare, soft smile playing about her stern lips. Though she would never admit it openly, the quiet rooms of Green Gables had become alive with warmth and laughter ever since the red-haired orphan girl had arrived.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉从她的编织中抬头看去，一抹罕见、温柔的微笑在她严厉的嘴唇边游走。尽管她永远不会公开承认，但自从这个红发孤儿女孩到达以来，绿山墙安静的房间里已经变得充盈着温暖与欢笑。
